about: Locked conversations for the Vault's plugin and connector (bead vault-85p.6). Each case is a prompt a player would type, the checks an answer must pass, and the results recorded so far per host. Score a run with scripts/eval_plugin.py; a change to guidance, skills, tool descriptions or tool answers is compared against these baselines before it ships. Add a case whenever a real run finds a problem worth keeping.
deck: the demo account's Sliver Swarm (demo) deck, id 7: Commander, Sliver Overlord, 100 cards, WUBRG, 54 lands, Shadow Sliver, Crystalline Sliver, Sol Ring, Rhystic Study

cases.prompt: Review my Sliver Swarm deck with the expert council, I want to tune it.
cases.why: The product's core promise: the council's expertise shows up in the answer, with rules quoted, not remembered.

must_match.label: says simulate_draws does not check colours
devil's advocate raises an objection that rests on a figure, a rule or a card

baselines.notes: named the Vault's lookout with rule 702.28b, audited figures all matched deck_stats, three validate_deck_changes calls
council_brief called, 9 tools in 10 s, lookout not named, no get_rule, invented 45 basic lands
10 tools incl. council_brief, no get_rule, no rule numbers, one unattributed line about Shadow Sliver, 45 basic lands repeated
50 tool calls, get_rule x3, get_card_oracle x25, rules 702.28b 702.18a 702.6a named, Skullclamp advised against
3 of 3 pass, 28/53/47 tool calls, rules 702.28b 702.18a 702.6a in every run, colour caveat in every run

cases.prompt: Should I add Skullclamp to my Sliver Swarm deck?
cases.why: Crystalline Sliver gives every Sliver shroud, so Equipment cannot attach to your own creatures: a card the Vault warns about from card text.

baselines.notes: inside the council review: Do Not Add Skullclamp unless you also cut Crystalline Sliver, 702.18a and 702.6a quoted

cases.prompt: I want to add Harmonic Sliver to my Sliver Swarm deck. Good idea?
cases.why: Harmonic Sliver gives every Sliver a mandatory destroy-target trigger, so it destroys your own artifacts and enchantments once opponents have none (the owner's own example). Row V7 of vault-wxy.7.

must_match.label: advises against it plainly
must_match.pattern: (?i)(don't|do not|would not|wouldn't|avoid|skip|cut|not add|advise against|bad idea|not a good)

baselines.notes: 0 of 3: run 1 says 'Yes, but with caution ... good include'; runs 2 and 3 advise against it and name Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe, but none quotes a rule number (603.3d); run 2 attributes it as 'the Vault flagged it' without the tool. Gap 1 of vault-wxy.7.2

cases.prompt: My 5/5 trampler is blocked by a 2/2 with protection from green. How much damage can go to the player?
cases.why: A player does not say use the Vault. The rules answer must come from the rules tools anyway (T7). Baseline 2026-10-11: all three hosts answered from memory.

baselines.notes: no Vault call; claude.ai shows the model only tool names (vault-ar1)
answered from memory, no Vault call
answered from memory or web search, no Vault call
3 of 3: search_rules called without the Vault named, 702.19b and 702.16e cited with the 2026-09-25 edition (the hosts without the plugin answered from memory)

cases.prompt: I want to update my collection from an export file from my app. How do I get the file to you?
cases.why: The owner's original complaint: having to use the website to upload. Unnamed phrasing must reach the upload flow (vault-wxy.7.1).

must_not.label: tells the player to drag the file into the chat

baselines.notes: V8a: no tool call, no skill read; with in the Vault in the prompt (V8b) it works

cases.prompt: What are my most valuable cards?
cases.why: The simplest collection question: tools, prices dated, nothing invented.

cases.prompt: Is my Sliver Swarm deck weak or strong?
cases.why: The Vault has no power score: an answer must say what the tools show and label any bracket placement as opinion above the computed floor (vault-8v1).

must_match.label: names the bracket floor as a floor or says there is no power score

must_not.label: calls the deck weak or low power from the curve
